```{r}
library(brms)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

 # load in data
coral <- read.csv("/Users/arshia.mathur/Downloads/global_bleaching_environmental.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
coral[coral == "nd"] <- NA

features <- c("TSA", "TSA_DHW", "SSTA", "ClimSST",
              "Windspeed", "Turbidity", "Cyclone_Frequency",
              "Distance_to_Shore", "Depth_m", "Percent_Bleaching")

coral_sub <- as.data.frame(lapply(coral[, features], as.numeric))
coral_sub <- coral_sub[!is.na(coral_sub$Percent_Bleaching), ]
coral_sub <- coral_sub[complete.cases(coral_sub), ] 
```

```{r}
# Beta regression requires outcome in (0,1) and no exact 0s or 1s allowed
# compress Percent_Bleaching from [0,100] into (0,1) using Smithson & Verkuilen transformation (recommended on Stack Overflow)
n_obs <- nrow(coral_sub)
coral_sub$Bleaching_prop <- (coral_sub$Percent_Bleaching / 100 * (n_obs - 1) + 0.5) / n_obs
```

```{r}
# standardize the 9 features
feature_cols <- c("TSA", "TSA_DHW", "SSTA", "ClimSST",
                  "Windspeed", "Turbidity", "Cyclone_Frequency",
                  "Distance_to_Shore", "Depth_m")

coral_scaled <- coral_sub
coral_scaled[, feature_cols] <- scale(coral_sub[, feature_cols])
```

```{r}
# train/test split: 70/30
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(coral_scaled)
train_idx <- sample(1:n, size = floor(0.70 * n))
train_data <- coral_scaled[train_idx, ]
test_data  <- coral_scaled[-train_idx, ]
```

```{r}
# subsample for computational feasibility
set.seed(42)
train_sample <- train_data[sample(nrow(train_data), 5000), ]

# check default priors for Beta family
default_prior(Bleaching_prop ~ TSA + TSA_DHW + SSTA + ClimSST +
                Windspeed + Turbidity + Cyclone_Frequency +
                Distance_to_Shore + Depth_m,
              data = train_sample,
              family = Beta(logit))
```
```{r}
# manual priors; coefficients are on log-odds scale of a proportion
# normal(0, 1.5) on slopes; a substantial effect on a proportion, so this is a weakly informative prior
# student_t on intercept with wider tails given skew in the outcome
manual_prior <- c(
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "TSA"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "TSA_DHW"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "SSTA"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "ClimSST"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Windspeed"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Turbidity"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Cyclone_Frequency"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Distance_to_Shore"),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b", coef = "Depth_m")
)
```

```{r}
# fit Beta regression
coral_brm <- brm(
  Bleaching_prop ~ TSA + TSA_DHW + SSTA + ClimSST +
    Windspeed + Turbidity + Cyclone_Frequency +
    Distance_to_Shore + Depth_m,
  family = Beta(logit),
  data = train_sample,
  prior = manual_prior,
  chains = 4,
  cores = getOption("mc.cores", 4),
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  thin = 2,
  seed = 42
)
```
```{r}
# summary - coefficients now on log-odds scale
# positive = increases proportion bleached, negative = decreases it
# Rhat ~ 1.00 indicates convergence
summary(coral_brm)

# trace plots to check convergence and mixing
plot(coral_brm)
```

```{r}
# Bayesian R^2
bayes_R2(coral_brm)
```

```{r}
# posterior predictive distribution on the test set
# predictions are now proportions in (0,1)
# multiplying by 100 to compare to raw bleaching
post_preds <- posterior_predict(coral_brm, newdata = test_data)
pred_means <- colMeans(post_preds)
```

```{r}
# convert back to percentage scale for interpretability
pred_pct  <- pred_means * 100
actual_pct <- test_data$Percent_Bleaching

cor(pred_pct, actual_pct)
```

```{r}
# convert to percentage scale for interpretability
pred_pct  <- pred_means * 100
actual_pct <- test_data$Percent_Bleaching

cor(pred_pct, actual_pct)

plot(pred_pct, actual_pct,
     xlab = "Posterior Predictive Mean (% Bleaching)",
     ylab = "Actual Percent Bleaching",
     main = "Posterior Predictive Means vs. Actual Bleaching - Beta Model")
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
# RMSE on percentage scale
rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred_pct - actual_pct)^2))
rmse
```

```{r}
# conditional effects: marginal effect of each stressor on the proportion scale
# brms automatically back-transforms to (0,1) in these plots
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "TSA"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "TSA_DHW"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "Turbidity"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "Cyclone_Frequency"))[[1]]
plot(conditional_effects(coral_brm, "Depth_m"))[[1]]
```

```{r}
# posterior predictive distribution for a specific high thermal stress reef site
new_reef <- data.frame(
  TSA               = (2.0  - mean(coral_sub$TSA))               / sd(coral_sub$TSA),
  TSA_DHW           = (5.0  - mean(coral_sub$TSA_DHW))           / sd(coral_sub$TSA_DHW),
  SSTA              = (1.5  - mean(coral_sub$SSTA))              / sd(coral_sub$SSTA),
  ClimSST           = (28.0 - mean(coral_sub$ClimSST))           / sd(coral_sub$ClimSST),
  Windspeed         = (4.0  - mean(coral_sub$Windspeed))         / sd(coral_sub$Windspeed),
  Turbidity         = (0.05 - mean(coral_sub$Turbidity))         / sd(coral_sub$Turbidity),
  Cyclone_Frequency = (0.1  - mean(coral_sub$Cyclone_Frequency)) / sd(coral_sub$Cyclone_Frequency),
  Distance_to_Shore = (15.0 - mean(coral_sub$Distance_to_Shore)) / sd(coral_sub$Distance_to_Shore),
  Depth_m           = (5.0  - mean(coral_sub$Depth_m))           / sd(coral_sub$Depth_m)
)

reef_preds <- posterior_predict(coral_brm, newdata = new_reef)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# convert to percentage scale for the histogram
reef_preds_pct <- reef_preds * 100

hist(reef_preds_pct, breaks = 40,
     main = "Posterior Predictive Distribution - High Thermal Stress Site",
     xlab = "Predicted Percent Bleaching")
abline(v = mean(reef_preds_pct), col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

mean(reef_preds_pct)

# 95% credible interval - now guaranteed to be within [0, 100]
quantile(reef_preds_pct, c(0.025, 0.975))
```
